depiction.primary_object: two right-angled arrows forming a clockwise loop
depiction.composition: centered symbol with two opposing arrows enclosing a single digit

readings.meaning: repeat one track or item (single-item loop mode)

ambiguity: At very small sizes the central numeral 1 can blur into a vertical line, making it look like a generic refresh, sync, or repeat-all icon.

modifier_semantics.meaning: single item, one time, or current track only

reasoning: This icon is standard media-player interface chrome for 'repeat one track' (single-item loop mode). Because it represents a playback state or recurrence setting rather than a concrete task object or domain, it has almost no natural fit as a to-do item subject outside of building a media player.
